Storj is a decentralized cloud storage network that distributes encrypted file pieces across independent node operators. Storj uses erasure coding so that stored files can be recovered from a subset of their pieces. Storj uses the STORJ token as its payment token for storage and bandwidth.

Arweave is a blockchain-based protocol for permanent data storage. Arweave is designed around a one-time upfront payment intended to fund long-term storage. Arweave uses the AR token. Arweave uses a Proof of Access consensus mechanism that requires miners to store historical data.

Filecoin is a decentralized storage network that pays storage providers in the FIL token. Filecoin uses Proof of Replication and Proof of Spacetime to verify that providers store data. Filecoin is built on the libp2p networking stack.

Golem is a decentralized marketplace for computing power. Golem uses the GLM token for payments between requestors and providers. Golem was initially launched on Ethereum.

Band is a cross-chain data oracle platform that delivers off-chain data to smart contracts. Band uses the BAND token. Band runs on a blockchain built with the Cosmos SDK.
